caption: The drawing depicts a square ornamental pattern resembling a woven textile or carpet. The composition is centered within a wide red border, surrounded by a thin inner gold line. The interior of the square displays a symmetrical arrangement with a central motif made up of green, blue, and white petal-like shapes forming a cross pattern. Surrounding the central motif is a series of green shapes and small, blocky yellow and blue elements. A prominent, jagged yellow outline further demarcates the central area. The corners and edges of the inner composition feature stylized floral and leaf patterns in shades of green, yellow, pink, blue, and off-white against a black background. The outermost red border is uninterrupted, except for small flower-like decorations aligned along its inner margin. The entire patterned area appears to be rendered in a pixelated or grid-like fashion, resembling needlework or embroidery. The drawing is set against a plain beige or off-white background, with a signature visible in the bottom right corner.
title: Needlepoint Tapestry
